verdict.rationale: Relay's own docs say it syncs detailed transaction data directly into QuickBooks Online and Xero, and that receipts and categorized expenses sync to accounting software automatically. That covers the core of the story: automatic sync of transactions and expenses with accounting software. The evidence is limited to vendor marketing claims with no setup docs or independent confirmation. Missing for 10: support documentation on setup, field mapping and sync frequency; independent or hands-on corroboration that the sync works; evidence of accounting platforms beyond QBO and Xero.
